thesis: Only specified implementations with distinguishing predictions admit empirical discrimination.
role: Bound possible simulation evidence and competing explanations.

ideas.statement: Undetectability can result from observational equivalence even without concealment; a lattice test constrains its model rather than every simulation.
Quantum measurement, anomalies or intelligent messages do not by themselves identify external implementation; correlated advance predictions still need rival comparisons.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A project can improve clocks, noise characterization or symmetry tests without finding simulation.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Decoherence does not settle every quantum interpretation, and a communicative intelligence is not thereby outside the universe.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
